title: Uneven, stiff turns
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: This is a contrast clip, not a drill to practise.
Stiff legs and a hurried rhythm make turns uneven.
Watch how the humps change size and spacing.

callouts.text: Humps of different heights: some turns get more tilt than others.
Uneven spacing: the rhythm speeds up and slows down.
Compare with the smooth carving video. Stiff legs flex far less.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
